lines.text: Skip the line.|Fill in the QR first.
Then the gate opened,|and the line stayed behind me.
One QR code.|That's the whole trick.
Fill it in before you land.|Immigration and customs, one form.
Show the QR code|at the e-gate.|Passport out, code ready.
No QR?|Paper forms still work.|They just take forever.
That's Japan first times.|Follow for more.
